name: diff-sharing
description: Generate Git or Difftastic code-diff sites for local preview or ngrok sharing.

interface.shortDescription: Share Difftastic-first code diffs through ngrok.
interface.longDescription: Generates a static Difftastic-first structural diff site with a Git fallback, inline and side-by-side layouts, then exposes it through ngrok.
defaultPrompt: Generate a Difftastic-first code diff and expose it publicly.
